rule: A method may be selected only when its preconditions are checked; registry presence does not imply execution capability or mathematical correctness.

preconditions: pinned Lean toolchain and dependency lock
verification: exact source revision and source digest
limits: Lean success proves only the encoded statement under imported assumptions

preconditions: known theorem nodes and directional edges
limits: only verified theorem nodes may be treated as proof evidence
analogy is not proof; transferred assumptions require independent checking

preconditions: domain objects and applicable definitions identified
verification: candidate formalization and Lean when formalizable
limits: skills are generation procedures, not specialized certified solvers

preconditions: one load-bearing assumption or boundary condition isolated
verification: explicit counterexample, executable test, or formal derivation
skeptic gate then candidate formalization/Lean or a domain-specific experiment
limits: novelty and unfamiliarity are not evidence; speculative mechanisms remain hypotheses

verification: recorded downstream verified outcomes and cost
limits: heuristic ranking is not a general-purpose mathematical optimizer

preconditions: stable episode ID and event payload
verification: recompute event/payload hashes and previous-event chain
limits: hash integrity proves record identity/integrity, not truth of event payload

methods.executor: existing research/evaluation benchmark ledgers and smoke tests
verification: replayable test results and paired comparisons
limits: not a general statistical inference package; report sample size and uncertainty

verification: proper scoring rules and calibration on held-out data
limits: may be proposed conceptually; do not claim executable Bayesian inference capability

verification: independent numerical implementation and analytic checks
limits: do not infer entropy or information gain from labels alone

preconditions: typed state, units, equations, solver assumptions and stability conditions
verification: independent numerical solver, convergence/error bounds, counterexample tests
limits: no general certified solver is implied by this registry

methods.executor: protocol task-generation/evaluation design; runtime adapter supplies procedure
verification: paired invariance and load-bearing answer-flip tests
limits: not yet integrated as a production training or evaluation service

promotion_rule: Capability status may change only after implementation and measured qualification. Registry labels never grant authority or upgrade evidence.
